name: Klevo Group Limited
summary: Klevo Group Limited provides membership services and loyalty programs for corporate and retail clients. Its customized solutions include employee engagement and recognition; customer loyalty and retention; member loyalty and rewards; and rewards-based advertising. The company also offers KLV Points Platform Klevo, a consumer-facing loyalty platform that combines blockchain technology, AI-driven analytics, and mobile-first design. In addition, it offers FlyWallet, a platform that enables members to manage and redeem their loyalty assets for global travel experiences. Klevo Group Limited was formerly known as Klevo Rewards Limited and changed its name to Klevo Group Limited in August 2026. Klevo Group Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in North Sydney, Australia.
